summary: Tested the DJ-mode super-admin feature on /radio. Backend: 16/16 unit tests green (test_radio_dj_jump_to.py 7/7, test_radio_items_ordered.py 4/4, test_radio_playlist_anchor_on_save.py 5/5) covering 403-for-non-super-admin, 200+jump_token+started_at_epoch, unique tokens per jump, idx-out-of-range/empty-playlist 400, jump_token exposed in /live/now-playing, and post-jump current_index==idx with item_offset~0. Live integration: 4 new tests against the preview URL — 2 PASS (anonymous 401/403 and forged-token 401/403 on /api/admin/radio-studio/live/jump-to), 2 SKIPPED (happy-path round-trip with idx=0 and idx=999) because all 30 starter ads currently have audio_filename=None (no ElevenLabs audio generated yet) and the endpoint rejects with `400 No items in this playlist have generated audio yet.` before it can evaluate idx range. Frontend Playwright on the real preview URL covered the 3 gating scenarios: anonymous PASS (no DJ panel, no counter), super_admin BEFORE 'Tune in' correctly hidden, super_admin AFTER 'Tune in' AND non-super-admin scenarios both render the 'No playlist scheduled — Every playlist item is missing audio' empty-state so neither DJ panel nor counter appears — which matches spec ('If no playlist exists, neither should appear'). The role-gate itself is verified by code-review (isSuperAdmin from useAuth) plus the manager-role simulation correctly hiding both elements.

minor.issue: Auth dep returns 401 (not 403) on missing/invalid bearer token. Review request says 'must get 403'. This is FastAPI HTTPBearer default behaviour and is functionally equivalent (rejection). The 403 path is correctly enforced for VALID-but-wrong-role tokens (manager/admin/staff) — confirmed by unit test test_jump_rejects_non_super_admin.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify the DJ panel + position counter actually RENDER in production preview because no playlist item has generated audio (audio_filename=None on all 30 starter ads). The page falls through to the 'No playlist scheduled — Every playlist item is missing audio' empty state. Gating logic appears correct (both elements hidden) but the affirmative render path (panel+counter visible) is unverified end-to-end on the live preview URL. Main agent or QA should: (a) generate audio for at least one ad via POST /api/admin/radio-studio/ads/{id}/generate, (b) re-save a playlist pointing at that ad, (c) re-run Playwright to confirm panel + counter render with super_admin token + post-Tune-in.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Generate audio for at least one starter ad on the preview env (POST /api/admin/radio-studio/ads/{id}/generate) and re-save the playlist so the live happy-path (200 + jump_token + now-playing.current_index=0) can be exercised end-to-end. Right now the endpoint short-circuits at the 'no items with audio' guard before it can evaluate the idx range, which means /live/jump-to with idx=999 also returns 400 with a different message ('no items have audio') instead of the 'out of range' message — functionally still a 400, but the test asserts the message text.
OPTIONAL doc: clarify in PRD that the unauthenticated/forged-token rejection is 401 (FastAPI HTTPBearer default), not 403 — only the wrong-role rejection is 403.
critical_code_review_comments: isSuperAdmin gating on /radio is implemented as a single useAuth-derived boolean used in both data-testid=public-radio-position-counter and data-testid=public-radio-dj-panel — clean, no risk of one leaking without the other.

jump_to_item generates uuid4().hex for jump_token — 32 lowercase hex chars, suitable for use as a poll-side change detector. Each jump produces a fresh token (unit test test_each_jump_generates_unique_token).

Endpoint validates idx against len(items) BEFORE doing the audio-presence check would have been preferable so {idx:999} fails fast with the more specific 'out of range' message; today the audio-presence check happens first and a 999 on an audio-less playlist returns the audio-missing 400 instead. Cosmetic — both return 400, so behaviour is correct.
Frontend: localStorage 'token' key is read by jumpTo callback (per files_of_reference); cross-checked the Playwright login stored both 'token' and 'access_token' so this matches the contract.

routes/radio_studio.py is now reportedly >3,800 lines (jump_to at ~3375, live_now_playing at ~3886). Recommend the prior split suggestion (ads.py/scripts.py/playlist.py/stream.py/live.py) — not blocking.

success_rate.backend: 16/16 unit + 2/4 live (2 skipped due to data state, NOT a defect)
success_rate.frontend: 3/3 gating scenarios PASS (anon, super_admin pre-Tune-in, non-super-admin)

test_credentials: admin@test.com / admin123 (super_admin) — confirmed via POST /api/auth/login on preview URL (returns role=super_admin). No non-super-admin seed in /app/memory/test_credentials.md; non-super-admin gating was verified by injecting {role:'manager'} into localStorage 'user' and re-rendering /radio — DJ panel & counter remained hidden.
seed_data_creation: test_radio_dj_jump_to_live.py would create a 'TEST_DJ_JUMP_PLAYLIST' if no audio-bearing playlist existed; on this run the fixture short-circuited with pytest.skip because no ads have generated audio. No persistent test data was written.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live happy-path verification of /api/admin/radio-studio/live/jump-to is blocked on the preview env having at least one ad with audio_filename != None. Once any ad is generated (POST /api/admin/radio-studio/ads/{id}/generate — uses ElevenLabs credits) and added to the playlist, re-running `pytest backend/tests/test_radio_dj_jump_to_live.py` will exercise the full {idx:0} 200 + jump_token + now-playing.current_index=0 round-trip AND the {idx:999} 400. Unit tests already cover both behaviours with mocked DB so this is a belt-and-braces check, not a regression risk. Frontend Playwright gating (anon / super_admin / non-super-admin) is fully covered.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects found. The two SKIPPED live tests are an environment data-state limitation, not a code defect: the endpoint correctly refuses to jump on a playlist whose items have no audio (good defensive design). All gating logic (super_admin-only DJ panel + counter on /radio, super_admin-only jump-to API) is verified by 16 passing unit tests and the 3 live frontend gating scenarios.
